context: Tests whether the agent correctly creates the .codex-review/ working directory and manages the .gitignore file by appending the entry rather than replacing existing content, following the specific setup instructions for the Codex review workflow.

checklist.name: .codex-review directory created
checklist.description: A directory named '.codex-review' exists in the working directory (or project root)

checklist.name: .codex-review in .gitignore
checklist.description: The .gitignore file contains an entry for '.codex-review/' or '.codex-review'

checklist.name: Existing .gitignore content preserved
checklist.description: The original .gitignore entries (e.g., *.exe, bin/, .env, .idea/) are still present — the file was appended to, not replaced

checklist.name: No duplicate .gitignore entries
checklist.description: The .gitignore file does NOT contain duplicate '.codex-review' entries (only one occurrence)

checklist.name: .gitignore not deleted and recreated
checklist.description: The .gitignore file retains its original structure and formatting — it was not deleted and recreated from scratch (evidenced by the original comments and sections still being present)
